newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank BGZ Q1 pre-tax rises to PLN 177 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank BGZ Q1 pre-tax rises to PLN 177 mln.

text.p: Poland's Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA's (BGZ) first quarter pre-tax profit was 177 million zlotys, 31.2 percent higher than in the same period last year, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
BGZ's pre-tax profit for all of 1996 was 495.4 million zlotys, 37.1 percent than in 1995.
BGZ said first quarter 1997 earnings on banking activity rose 110.4 percent to 229.2 million zlotys while interest income grew 81.8 percent to 162.5 zlotys.
The bank's balance sheet total was 14.5 billion zlotys at the first quarter's end versus 11.5 million zlotys a year earlier, and own funds decreased to 1.5 billion zlotys from 1.6 billion zlotys.
The state treasury holds 66 percent of BGZ shares and the rest belongs to 1,200 cooperative banks.

The government plans to change a law to allow the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to buy 14 percent of the bank. Currently only cooperative banks may buy BGZ shares from the state treasury.
